items.title: [ECG] SUSS Campus Exploration Day 2026 (Fri, 27 Nov, 2:30 PM – 4:30 PM)
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please take note that
SUSS
is hosting
Campus Exploration Day 2026
on
Friday, 27 November 2026
at 2.30PM - 4.30PM. If you're interested in attending, please register at your own accord via the link below.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Greetings from the Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS)!
Following our inaugural Campus Exploration Day in June 2026, we are excited to invite your students and their parents to our
second Campus Exploration Day of the year
, taking place on Friday, 27 November 2026.
Event Details
Date:
Friday, 27 November 2026
Time:
2:30 PM – 4:30 PM (Registration starts at 2:00 PM)
Venue:
Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS)
Be Part of Our Campus Exploration Day 2026!
Step onto the SUSS campus and experience university life firsthand! Explore our
full-time undergraduate programmes
and flexible learning pathways, and connect with our friendly recruitment officers and students to gain valuable insights into studying at SUSS.
Discover what makes a SUSS education truly distinctive, from our industry-relevant curriculum to our flexible and applied learning approach.
Parents are also welcome to join their children
to learn more about SUSS and explore the educational opportunities available.
Planning a group visit of 10 or more? Feel free to reach out to us at
sandrahomc@suss.edu.sg
for assistance.
Register now to receive an exclusive gift and enjoy complimentary afternoon tea!
We can't wait to welcome you to campus!
REGISTER NOW
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thank you.
Best regards,
Justin
ECG Department

items.title: [Library] Discover our New Book : Lee Hsien Loong and Singapore
items.author: Lee Pui Wah
items.description:
Dear Students,
What does it take to lead a nation through changing times and shape its future?
Step into the world of Singapore's leadership and nation-building through
Lee Hsien Loong and Singapore
. This book offers readers an opportunity to learn more about the life, leadership and contributions of Singapore's third Prime Minister, Lee Hsien Loong, and his role in guiding Singapore through significant milestones and challenges.
From national development and economic transformation to social progress and Singapore's place on the global stage, discover the stories, decisions and experiences behind the nation's journey.
Whether you are interested in Singapore's history, politics, leadership or simply curious about the people who have shaped our nation, this is a book worth exploring.
Copies of this book are now available to borrow from Kong Chian Library and Jingxian Library.
To access the
eBook
, please check out on the
link
in the brochure attached.
Make this a must-read during the Year-end school holidays.
Warmest regards,
HCI Libraries
